description: Send one claim to be checked at its primary source and graded. Returns a receipt ID. A person reviews every submission before any answer is released; nothing is instant.

acknowledge.description: Must be true: this is not legal, medical, or financial advice, no lawyer-client relationship is formed, and no confidential information is included.

claim.description: The claim to check, in one or two sentences, quoted as you found it.

contact_email.description: Optional. If given, a person may email you when the answer is released.

context.description: Where you saw the claim and why it matters to you. Optional.

publish_ok.description: May Eous publish the claim and its grade on the public ledger, without names? Default no.

sources.description: Where the claim says it comes from: URLs or citations, up to 10.

name: submit_claim
title: Submit a claim to be checked
